body:
For me, and I feel fine, really it's easy, but obviously when you lose it for just 24 hours and it is sitting in front of you, it's a whole different mater, maybe we should start up the 101 things to do with a Wispa again, you have to go a long way back for that one, or do some single player stuff, or watch DVD, not a movie of your PC as you need to be on line for some of them for the codecs, lol.

I hear the weather is fine in some places across the world, go enjoy it, or plant a tree, watch TV, write a blog, eat till ya puke, have consentual xes more than once, play WOW, got shopping, drink a large amout of milk till it comes out of your nose, read some old blogs, oh, find a book and read it, create a new food group, clean out the animal cage, fish tank, pond, do some gardening, learn a new language, find a comment that rofer has done that is longer than a paragraph😛, write a song, a film script, defrag your PC, Virus Check, delete old demos on you 360, change your phone plan, goxmas shopping if you celebrate that sort of thing, invent something to save the world, fart the alphabet without a follow through, see if monkeys can type, go to the zoo, watch TV without the volume on and put on your fav music and see if it sync's. Autumn cleaning, drunken DIY, stand in the middle of the town you live in and point until you get a crowd and then after an hour say your contacts were dirty, find a cheese that you have never eaten and try it.

Now I'm bored, making stuff up, your turn, but that Whispa and 101 uses is good fun, and that will give you something to do, finding that, oh, phone home, and tell some one you love them, and smile alot, it might be contagious or get you locked up, but at least you are doing something, just in a straight jacket.

Count how many spelling mistakes are in all my blogs, lol.

Enroll in something postive.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out? Still holding on, like the Duracel Bunny, just need a drum to bang.

Love you all, in a that special way, see ya my little yellow bus arrived! Ding! Ding!
